title: Bazaar e Shaam Zainab
body:
Haaye..Haaye..
Zainab aur shaam..(2)
Nabi ke roze par, sadaat ye karte the buka
ghareeb zainab kaise bhulaye shaam
balo ki safedi...
har zakhm dil ka, neel rasan ke
chashm e sajjad se wo behte hue khoon ke aansu
kehte hai..
<<MINI>>
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..(2)
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Gyarah (11) moharram karbobala se
shaam chali Ahmed ki nawasi
saath alam ke surkh pharera
naizo pe sar chehro pe udaasi
<<DIVIDER>>
lekar nishaan.. zainab
be sayebaan.. zainab
thi nauha khwaan.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shaam sheher mein jis dum pohche
mehwe buka thi aale payambar
shehnayi ki goonj thi har soo
aag barasti thi kahi'n patthar
<<DIVIDER>>
ghum se nidhaal.. zainab
thi pur malaal.. zainab
wo istaqbaal.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Shehr e halab mein qafla pohcha
taaza qayamat waqt ne dhayi
gard e safar chehro pe padi thi
shiree'n hamein pehchaan na payi
<<DIVIDER>>
kunbe ki zayn.. zainab
wo shoro shayn.. zainab
shiree'n ke bayn.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Naize pe dekha akbar ka sar
kufe mein boli ek zaeefa
aye kaash teri maut se pehle
mar gayi ho teri madar dukhiya
<<DIVIDER>>
lab tashnkaam.. zainab
han wo kalaam.. zainab
badr-ut-tamaam.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chalte hue naaqe se giri thi
raah mein jab masoom sakina
dhundhne nikli zainab dukhiya
daadi ke pehlu mein use paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
thi beqaraar.. zainab
aa dil figaar.. zainab
maa ki pukaar.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shaam ki galiyo'n aur koocho mein
nauha kuna aulad e nabi thi
ehle haram sab be parda the
charo taraf mahaul sharabi
<<DIVIDER>>
bint e ameer.. zainab
hoke aseer.. zainab
nazro ke teer.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ehle haram ke dil pe likhi hai
kaan'to bhari abid ki musafat
wo tees ghante kaise bhulaein
aale nabi aur baab e sa'at
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pehli baar.. zainab
pohchi darbaar.. zainab
wo intezaar.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Pehli majlis qaid e jafa mein
barpa hui irfan aur mazhar
pohchi madine paa ke rehayi
nana se boli zainab e muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar e shaam.. zainab
darbaar e shaam.. zainab
zindaan e shaam.. zainab
<<MINI>>
kaise bhulaye
bazaar e shaam zainab, darbaar e shaam zainab..
zindan e shaam zainab kaise bhulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab aur shaam...
